column2: Fanatics of [Root.Religion.GetName] have risen in [Root.GetName]! Ragged preachers rail against the laxity of the priesthood, mobs flog themselves in the streets and drag out those they call unbelievers. Left alone they will spread to every county around - it would be wise to send my priests to bring them to heel.
The faith needs no such friends

Maddened fanatics of the [From.Religion.GetName] heresy are spreading like wildfire in [From.GetName], and [From.Holder.TopLiege.GetTitledName] has done nothing to stop them. As head of the true [Root.Religion.GetName] faith I cannot let this festering error stand. In the name of [Root.Religion.GetRandomGodName], something must be done!
Send a Holy Inquest!
Send an envoy to [From.Holder.TopLiege.GetTitledName]
Send learned priests to reason with them
My hands are tied
A Holy Inquest of priest-investigators and armed guards is sent
An envoy is sent to [This.GetTitledName]
A group of learned priests is sent

[From.GetTitledFirstName] has sent a Holy Inquest to [Root.GetName]: grim priest-investigators with their ledgers and branding irons, and a column of armed guards to see their questions answered. The fanatics will be found, and those who will not repent will burn.
A messy affair...

The Holy Inquest is returning to [FromFrom.Capital.GetName] after two years in [Root.GetName]. They burned a few beggars and a midwife, found none of the fanatics' leaders and left the whole county seething.
So, now it's my problem
The Holy Inquest in [From.GetName] has failed - the fanatics were too entrenched, and the common folk hid them from my inquisitors.
Curse these zealots!

The pyres in [Root.GetName] have burned out. The leaders of the fanatics are ash, their followers have recanted on their knees, and the inquisitors are returning to [FromFrom.Capital.GetName] with the county won back to [FromFrom.Religion.GetName].
Well, that is a surprise!
The Holy Inquest in [From.GetName] has succeeded - the fanatics are broken and the county is returned to the true faith.
Praise [Root.Religion.GetRandomGodName]!

An envoy of [From.GetTitledName] has arrived at my court, bearing a letter sealed with the sign of [From.Religion.GetName]. The [From.PrimaryTitle.GetRulerTitle] is gravely concerned by the fanatics in [FromFrom.GetName] and expects me to root them out.
It shall be done within ten years!
The fanatics in [From.GetName] have been rooted out, as my envoy bade [From.Holder.TopLiege.GetTitledName]. Such obedience deserves a reward.
Send 100¤ to show my gratitude
Proclaim [From.Holder.TopLiege.GetTitledFirstName]'s piety to the world
Lift the excommunication on [From.Holder.TopLiege.GetTitledFirstName]
[This.GetTitledFirstName] receives my gift
[This.GetTitledFirstName] gets 200 Piety
The excommunication is lifted from [This.GetTitledFirstName]
[From.GetTitledName] has sent me 100¤ in gratitude for rooting out the fanatics in [FromFrom.GetName].
Praise [Root.Religion.GetRandomGodName]
[From.GetTitledName] has extolled my devotion before all the faithful in gratitude for rooting out the fanatics in [FromFrom.GetName].
[From.GetTitledName] has lifted my excommunication in gratitude for rooting out the fanatics in [FromFrom.GetName].
[From.GetTitledFirstName] has sent a group of learned priests to [Root.GetName], armed with nothing but scripture, patience and a cart of holy texts, to argue the fanatics back into the fold.
The [From.PrimaryTitle.GetRulerTitle] is wise

The learned priests sent to [Root.GetName] by the [FromFrom.PrimaryTitle.GetRulerTitle] are returning to [FromFrom.Capital.GetName] with their tails between their legs, pelted with dung on the way out.
I thought they were supposed to be good
The priests we sent to [From.GetName] have failed - the fanatics' preachers outshouted them at every turn.
Zealots! Renegades!

The learned priests sent to [Root.GetName] by the [FromFrom.PrimaryTitle.GetRulerTitle] are returning to [FromFrom.Capital.GetName] in triumph. The fanatics have laid down their scourges and their zeal.
Good!
The priests we sent to [From.GetName] have returned in triumph after convincing the fanatics to return to the fold.
Praise [Root.Religion.GetRandomGodName]!
Faith Triumphant

Word spreads from temple to temple: the [From.Religion.GetName] faith has grown so strong that the old [FromFrom.Religion.GetName] creed is now the heresy. Its priests are cast out of their shrines, its relics are carried off and its holy books rewritten. What was error yesterday is truth today.
The truth could not be hidden forever!
We few keep the true faith
Their quarrels are not mine
